name: Hanayamata: Yosakoi Live!
original_name: ハナヤマタ よさこいLIVE！
source: Naru Sekiya is an ordinary 14-year-old middle school girl who likes fairy tales, but is worried about her lack of other interests. She has a chance encounter with a "fairy", a foreign girl practicing dance at night. On a spur of the moment, Naru asks to join her and is introduced to the world of yosakoi dancing. The series' title is a portmanteau (combination) of the first two letters of the girls' first names: HAna, NAru, YAya, MAchi, and TAmi.
translation: 关谷鸣是一个普通的14岁中学生，喜欢童话，却为自己缺乏其他兴趣而烦恼。某天，她偶然遇见一名“妖精”——一个夜里练习舞蹈的外国女孩。鸣一时兴起，提出加入她，并由此接触到YOSAKOI舞蹈的世界。系列标题是女孩们名字前两个假名的组合：花（HAna）、鸣（NAru）、夜夜（YAya）、真智（MAchi）和多美（TAmi）。
